children: RNS Number : 1166T  Calculus VCT PLC  02 September 2026

The Board of Calculus VCT plc is pleased to announce that, in connection with the offer for subscription for Ordinary Shares of 1p each that opened on 3 October 2025 ("Offer"), an allotment of 33,625 Ordinary Shares ("New Shares") in respect of the 2026/2027 tax year has taken place today at an average issue price of 56.65 pence per share. Application for the New Shares to be admitted to trading on the London Stock Exchange's main market for listed securities has been made and it is expected that admission will take place on or around 3 September 2026.
